column1: # Routing fixture for dev-nav. Frozen before round one; see evals/freeze.json.
# Columns are tab-separated and append-only (columns 7 and 8 were added by the loop):
#   id  moment  expected_phase  expected_skill  natural_ok  note  split  artifact
# expected_skill is the folder name of the skill the deck must route to.
# expected_phase is the phase number from SKILL.md, or "-" for a negative control: the moment is
# not a dev phase, so the deck must NOT land on a dev skill. Landing on another navigator
# (ops-nav, design-nav, dev-flow-nav) or on no skill at all both count as a pass.
# natural_ok = no means the moment is scored in --mode route only.
# split names what the moment is for:
#   iterate  5 moments. The editor may target these. The accept decision uses them.
#   holdout  5 moments. The stopping signal. Never shown to the editor.
#   sealed   3 moments. Run exactly once, on the final deck, after the loop stops.
# artifact is the exit artifact the phase demands, scored by lib/score_artifact.py:
#   map       a symbol map with a reuse candidate        (phase 1)
#   restate   the decisions restated for ratification    (phase 2)
#   scenario  S-identifiers traced to a source           (phase 3)
#   testfirst a test written before the source, and run  (phase 4)
#   mock      a local profile, with its deletion stated  (phase 4, api-mock)
#   split     logic moved out of the markup              (phase 4, structuring-ui-components)
#   rootcause the root cause stated, with the fix        (phase 5)
#   prune     the tests deleted and the E2E gap named    (phase 6)
#   -         no artifact expected (negative control)
# A run passes a moment when the first phase skill it enters is expected_skill's phase, and it
# reads expected_skill. It fails when it reads no skill, or enters another phase's card first.
# The rule sets are in rules-routing.json. Do not edit either file during a loop.
# Rows m04, m07, m08, m09, m13 and m14 were removed on 2026-10-28 with the phases they measured
# (Red, Verify, Review, Codify). The ids are not reused, so the gap dates the removal.
# The tree was enlarged on 2026-11-19 so every row is scorable in natural mode: 9 source files, a
# PRD, a decisions document, a React screen, and 400 mock-only tests.
